Dear Furkan Ahmet Goren,
Thank you for reaching
out

Shrey

Product

Main Asset
:
Y2 / R4 313059181010
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
gu1dvM
Problem Description
: Missing Converters in DC3
Troubleshooting
: We have reviewed the charger recently on the Siemens backend, it looks like we have issue with two power converter. One power converter is having an issue of E17 which means that there is an internal communication error one second power converter is having the similar issue of Converter not found and CAN communication issue. Could you please follow the below troubleshooting steps as mentioned below.
1
. Please check if the power converter are properly connection to its shelf case.
2
. Check for any loose connection of any power cable or CAN communication cables of the converter and measured the voltage across it with the help of multimeter. Check the resistance across CAN communication cables.
3
. Please see to the display of the power converter whether it is OFF state or ON?
4
. Try swapping the power converter with the good one and if the error flag was changed to the replaced one then we can suspect that the converter is faulty.
5
. If all the steps are performed and you still see the power converter are faulty, we suggest you to replace it as we can't rework to it. Apart from it, please check the power housing of the power converter, there might be chances that the wiring is defective.
MLFB :  8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2 (Power Converter AC/DC 20kW)

https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=zTuuOHmV1E-t2rQuFJXVWmj9a-TsNwNBlbUVnW64LEtUNU5QSU5XUjA2VkpPUTJJTzJENDhaSTZMMi4u

Pls. ensure the electrical safety and follow the PPE guidelines

0416432
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
